description: This file defines a plugin for the openclaw framework that integrates GitHub Copilot as a provider. It includes functions for authentication, provider registration, and usage tracking.

methods.name: buildGithubCopilotReplayPolicy
methods.description: Builds a replay policy for GitHub Copilot based on the model ID, especially if it includes 'claude'.

methods.name: resolveFirstGithubToken
methods.description: Resolves the first available GitHub token from environment variables or user profiles.

methods.name: runGitHubCopilotAuth
methods.description: Handles the authentication flow for GitHub Copilot via device login.
